children: Ingram Micro entered into an Underwriting Agreement as selling stockholder Ingram Holdco launches a 13,125,000-share secondary offering, with a 30-day option for 1,968,750 additional shares. Goldman Sachs is the sole underwriter. The company repurchased 625,000 shares from the underwriter as part of the transaction, leaving $53,007,500 remaining under its $175 million buyback program. Ingram Holdco will receive all net proceeds, while the company covers offering costs other than underwriting discounts and commissions; no underwriting fees apply to the repurchased shares.
: Underwriting agreement for secondary offering of common stock
: Facilitate secondary offering and increase public float
